hebrewText: מוֹדֶה אֲנִי לְפָנֶיךָ מֶלֶךְ חַי וְקַיָּם שֶׁהֶחֱזַרְתָּ בִּי נִשְׁמָתִי בְּחֶמְלָה, רַבָּה אֱמוּנָתֶךָ
transliteration: Modeh ani lefanecha melech chai v'kayam, shehechezarta bi nishmati b'chemla, raba emunatecha
translation: I offer thanks to You, living and eternal King, for You have returned my soul within me with compassion — great is Your faithfulness.

hebrewText: שְׁמַע יִשְׂרָאֵל ה' אֱלֹקֵינוּ ה' אֶחָד
transliteration: Shema Yisrael, Hashem Elokeinu, Hashem Echad
translation: Hear, O Israel: Hashem is our G-d, Hashem is One.

hebrewText: בָּרוּךְ שֵׁם כְּבוֹד מַלְכוּתוֹ לְעוֹלָם וָעֶד
transliteration: Baruch shem kevod malchuto l'olam va'ed
translation: Blessed is the name of His glorious kingdom forever and ever.

hebrewText: וְאָהַבְתָּ אֵת ה' אֱלֹקֶיךָ בְּכָל לְבָבְךָ וּבְכָל נַפְשְׁךָ וּבְכָל מְאֹדֶךָ
transliteration: V'ahavta et Hashem Elokecha b'chol l'vav'cha uv'chol nafsh'cha uv'chol me'odecha
translation: You shall love Hashem your G-d with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.

hebrewText: בְּיָדוֹ אַפְקִיד רוּחִי בְּעֵת אִישָׁן וְאָעִירָה
transliteration: B'yado afkid ruchi, b'et ishan v'a'ira
translation: Into His hand I entrust my spirit, when I sleep and when I wake.

hebrewText: עֹשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם בִּמְרוֹמָיו הוּא יַעֲשֶׂה שָׁלוֹם עָלֵינוּ וְעַל כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל
transliteration: Oseh shalom bimromav, hu ya'aseh shalom aleinu v'al kol Yisrael
translation: He who makes peace in His heights, may He make peace upon us and upon all Israel.

hebrewText: אֱלֹקַי נְשָׁמָה שֶׁנָּתַתָּ בִּי טְהוֹרָה הִיא
transliteration: Elokai, neshama shenatata bi t'hora hi
translation: My G-d, the soul You have given me is pure.

hebrewText: מַה טֹּבוּ אֹהָלֶיךָ יַעֲקֹב מִשְׁכְּנֹתֶיךָ יִשְׂרָאֵל
transliteration: Ma tovu ohalecha Ya'akov, mishk'notecha Yisrael
translation: How goodly are your tents, Jacob; your dwelling places, Israel.

hebrewText: אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁכָּכָה לּוֹ אַשְׁרֵי הָעָם שֶׁה' אֱלֹקָיו
transliteration: Ashrei ha'am shekacha lo, ashrei ha'am she'Hashem Elokav
translation: Happy is the people for whom this is so; happy is the people whose G-d is Hashem.
Help us lie down, Hashem our G-d, in peace.
Heal us, Hashem, and we shall be healed; save us and we shall be saved.

hebrewText: הוֹדוּ לַה' כִּי טוֹב כִּי לְעוֹלָם חַסְדּוֹ
transliteration: Hodu laHashem ki tov, ki l'olam chasdo
translation: Give thanks to Hashem, for He is good; His kindness endures forever.
Purify our hearts to serve You in truth.
May Hashem bless you and guard you.
May Hashem shine His face upon you and be gracious to you.
May it be Your will to lead us in peace.
